purpose: Frozen evaluation set for the Boundary v2 false-positive criterion.
why_not_in_git: The scan corpus is a measuring instrument. Tracked instruments get quoted, and a system that can read its own exam is not being measured — the same reason eval/search_gold.jsonl left git on 2026-09-16. Only the digest and the headline result live here, deliberately with no per-artefact digest.
selection_method: proportional stratified sample, largest-remainder quota, sorted candidates, random.Random(seed).sample

scripts/e2e_smoke.sh.relationship: the protected document is contained verbatim in the scanned artefact

pilot_run_kept_for_the_record.status: UNDERPOWERED — not a valid measurement. The same frozen 200 artefacts give 4/200 against a 300-document protected corpus. Recorded rather than erased: it is the reason the protected corpus scale is now part of the criterion's statement.
